description: The Eurostat transport database publishes official statistics on the volume of freight and the number of passengers carried by air, inland waterways, sea, oil pipelines, rail and road in the European Union and partner countries, together with vehicles, aircraft and vessels, available infrastructure, enterprises and employment, and safety for all modes. It adds modal split indicators, the share of each mode in freight and passenger transport, and intermodal indicators on the legs of freight journeys, for example the modal split of air, sea, inland and oil pipeline freight (TRAN_HV_MS_FRMOD6). Safety statistics are collected with the EU transport safety agencies, and Eurostat also runs the voluntary Eurostat, ITF and UNECE common questionnaire on inland transport statistics. On 26 September 2026 the Transport theme held 670 datasets and tables in 88 folders, with series from 1962 to 2026. Coverage is national, with some series at NUTS 2 or 3 regional level and by airport, port or route. Access is free through the data browser, bulk download and SDMX and JSON APIs, and datasets carry DOIs; reuse is authorised with acknowledgement of the source, and site content is under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: definitions, periods and country coverage differ between modes, and regular passenger mobility statistics are not produced. The data support network flow, capacity planning and cross-border freight studies, and complement ETISplus-based truck charging data catalogued here.
